title: avenSANDBOX stays a required check
quote: Why remove avenSANDBOX? We still want it built and published, and AIP-2 does that anyway.
means: production's ruleset keeps all three required checks: Only from main, avenSANDBOX and theOS. theOS's release workflow reports avenSANDBOX as proof that the box of the commit released is published and works; AIP-2's image workflow builds it. Samuel set the source of theOS to GitHub Actions on 1 November, so nothing is left for him in GitHub's settings.

supersedes.what: avenSANDBOX stays a required check beside Only from main and theOS.

supersedes.part: in place of the old ones
supersedes.what: theOS's checks join the ruleset beside the old ones instead of replacing them.

reflection.result: supersedes D-63 in part (avenSANDBOX leaving at Gate B) and D-59 in part (checks replaced at Gate B)
